articles.title: FlightAware drops Kalshi lawsuit over a market niche that data shows it never took off
articles.snippet: The flight-tracking company voluntarily dismissed, without prejudice and without sharing a motive for its decision. However, the flight cancellation market never took off with Kalshi users.

articles.title: Bank of England to test stablecoin, digital currency use in cross-border finance
articles.snippet: The BOE-led Digital Pound Lab will test trade-finance interoperability, in which exporters receive stablecoins while importers settle in a potential digital pound.

articles.title: XRP bridge drained for $200,000 after software mistook fake deposits for real ones
articles.snippet: An attacker created unbacked XRP on another blockchain, then exchanged it for real XRP held in reserve. The bridge has been halted and its operator has filed a complaint with the FBI.

articles.title: CFTC orders Kalshi to continue offering prediction markets in New York after state lawsuit
articles.snippet: New York sued Kalshi last month in a bid to block it from operating sports-related prediction markets.

articles.title: FlightAware drops Kalshi lawsuit one day after filing
articles.snippet: Following the initial lawsuit, at least one of Kalshi’s event contracts was changed to list “Primary Source Agency” as the entity behind verifying flight cancellation data.
